test_bm_random_variable_decorator: test the bm.random_variable decorator to define a Normal distribution random variable
test_bm_functional_decorator: test the bm.functional decorator to define log sum exp probabilistic computations
test_bmg_inference_to_dot: test BMGInference to_dot method to generate a DOT graph from queries and observations
test_fix_logsumexp_optimization: test the FixLogSumExp compiler optimization that rewrites log(exp(x)+exp(y)) to logsumexp
test_logsumexp_graph_equivalence: test that log(exp(a)+exp(b)) and logsumexp produce equivalent probabilistic program graphs
